items.title: From a prompt to an operational dashboard: Generate Real-Time Dashboards with Copilot (Preview)
items.text: Sections: Start with the question, not a blank dashboard; Describe, refine, and create; Example: Connect transit arrivals with stadium gate load; Make the dashboard your own; Next steps. Which transit stations are sending the most fans toward a stadium? How does that incoming demand compare with activity at the gates? Where are queues building? Answering these operational questions traditionally requires translating them into tables, queries, visualizations, and a dashboard layout. When you already know what you want to monitor, that setup can get in the way of the question you are trying to answer. Copilot in Microsoft Fabric can generate a Real-Time Dashboard from a natural-language description of the insights you want. Working with a selected database in an Eventhouse, it uses the tables in that database to create a dashboard tailored to your goal. items.title: Nov 2, 2026: CoCo automations (General availability)
items.text: CoCo automations are now generally available and are no longer in Preview. Automations let you schedule recurring, unattended CoCo runs that execute in a Snowflake-managed sandbox. Each run creates a Cortex thread that you can open to inspect the agent's messages, tool calls, and results.
